meaning.en: A polite request: please do not hesitate to give me your advice or comments.
meaning.zh: 客气话，请对方不要吝惜，多给自己指教。

equivalents: please do not hesitate to advise me

examples.zh: 文章如有不当之处，敬请不吝赐教。
examples.en: If there are any errors in this article, please do not hesitate to correct me.

examples.zh: 初来乍到，还请各位前辈不吝赐教。
examples.en: I'm new here, so I hope my seniors will kindly guide me.

usage.en: Polite formula in letters, emails and speeches; always addressed to the other person. 吝 = lìn (stingy).
usage.zh: 客套话，用于书信、讲话，是对对方说的；“吝”读lìn。

literal: not · of the age · of · merit
natural: merit that comes once in a generation

meaning.en: An extraordinary achievement that rarely occurs in any age.
meaning.zh: 世上少有的、非凡的功绩。

examples.zh: 他为国家立下了不世之功。
examples.en: He rendered the country an unparalleled service.

examples.zh: 这项发明被誉为不世之功。
examples.en: The invention is hailed as a once-in-an-age achievement.

usage.en: Formal praise, usually for heroes, statesmen, great inventors. 不世 = rare in the world.
usage.zh: 正式的赞语，多用于英雄、政治家、发明家；“不世”指世间少有。

meaning.en: To reconcile and become friends again after a quarrel.
meaning.zh: 彼此重新和好。

examples.zh: 吵了一架之后，他们很快言归于好。
examples.en: After the quarrel they soon made up.

examples.zh: 两家的邻居终于言归于好。
examples.en: The two neighbours finally made peace.

usage.en: Predicate; common in news and daily talk. 言 here is a particle-like 'then'.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，新闻与日常皆常用；“言”为助词。

meaning.en: To hesitate and be unable to make up one's mind.
meaning.zh: 犹豫，拿不定主意。

equivalents: be unable to make up one's mind

examples.zh: 机会摆在眼前，他却迟疑不决。
examples.en: The opportunity was right there, yet he dithered.

examples.zh: 别迟疑不决了，赶紧报名吧。
examples.en: Stop dithering and sign up.

usage.en: Predicate; criticises indecision. Compare 犹豫不决 (more common).
usage.zh: 作谓语，批评优柔寡断；比“犹豫不决”略少用。

meaning.en: To be able to read and write; to be literate.
meaning.zh: 认识字，有基本文化。

examples.zh: 村里识文断字的人不多。
examples.en: Not many people in the village can read and write.

examples.zh: 她只读过两年书，勉强识文断字。
examples.en: She had only two years of school and could barely read and write.

usage.en: Describes basic literacy, often of rural or older people. Not praise for scholarship.
usage.zh: 指基本识字，多说农村或老一辈人；不是赞学问。

natural: the first Earthly Branches in order

meaning.en: The details or a rational explanation of something, usually in the phrase 说不出个子丑寅卯.
meaning.zh: 事情的条理、缘由，常用于“说不出个子丑寅卯”。

examples.zh: 你问他为什么，他也说不出个子丑寅卯。
examples.en: Ask him why and he can't give you a clear account.

examples.zh: 这件事得弄出个子丑寅卯来。
examples.en: We need to get to the bottom of this matter.

usage.en: Almost always in negative or 弄出个 (get to the bottom of) patterns; casual.
usage.zh: 几乎总是用于否定或“弄出个……”句式；口语。

literal: like · stirring up trouble · of · fellow
natural: a meddler who likes to stir things up

meaning.en: A busybody who meddles or loves to cause a stir.
meaning.zh: 喜欢多管闲事、惹是生非的人。

equivalents: a troublemaker who likes to stir

examples.zh: 几个好事之徒在网上散布谣言。
examples.en: A few busybodies spread rumours online.

examples.zh: 别理那些好事之徒。
examples.en: Ignore those busybodies.

usage.en: 好 is hào here (to like); 好事 (hào shì) = fond of meddling, not 好事 (hǎo shì, 'good deed').
usage.zh: “好”读hào，“好事”指爱管闲事；不要与“好事”(hǎo shì，善事)混淆。

meaning.en: No more than that; not as good as hoped or said to be.
meaning.zh: 不过如此，没有什么了不起。

examples.zh: 传说中的名胜，亲眼看来不过尔尔。
examples.en: The much-hyped sight turned out to be nothing special.

examples.zh: 他自认为名校毕业，对别人的成绩总觉得不过尔尔。
examples.en: As a top-school graduate, he thought others' results were nothing special.

usage.en: Used when disappointed or dismissive; can sound arrogant. 尔尔 = 'so and so'.
usage.zh: 用于失望或轻视，有时显得傲慢；“尔尔”意为如此而已。

meaning.en: A person of honour keeps his word; usually the full saying 君子一言，驷马难追.
meaning.zh: 有德之人说话算数；常用全句“君子一言，驷马难追”。

equivalents: a gentleman's word is his bond

examples.zh: 君子一言，驷马难追，答应你的事我一定办到。
examples.en: A gentleman's word cannot be recalled even by four horses; I will do what I promised.

examples.zh: 他向来君子一言，从不反悔。
examples.en: He is a man of his word and never goes back on it.

usage.en: Normally with 驷马难追 ('even a team of four horses can't catch it'). A formal pledge or a comment on someone's reliability.
usage.zh: 常与“驷马难追”连用，用于郑重承诺或评价人守信。

natural: make up out of thin air

meaning.en: To fabricate something with no basis in fact.
meaning.zh: 毫无根据地编造。

equivalents: make up out of thin air

examples.zh: 这些谣言完全是凭空捏造的。
examples.en: These rumours are pure fabrication.

examples.zh: 他凭空捏造证据，想陷害同事。
examples.en: He fabricated evidence to frame his colleague.

usage.en: Common in news about rumours and fraud; usually with 的 or as predicate.
usage.zh: 常见于辟谣、诈骗新闻；多作谓语或带“的”。

literal: rank · reach the top · subject · official
natural: rank at the summit of subjects

meaning.en: To reach the highest rank a subject can hold, as prime minister.
meaning.zh: 官位做到了臣子能达到的最高地步。

equivalents: rise to the highest rank under the throne

examples.zh: 他官至宰相，位极人臣。
examples.en: He rose to prime minister, the top of the officials.

examples.zh: 位极人臣的他，晚年却选择归隐。
examples.en: Having reached the highest rank, he retired to the countryside in old age.

usage.en: Neutral to admiring; sometimes warns that peak status is perilous. Literary.
usage.zh: 中性或赞许，有时暗含功高震主的警示；书面语。

natural: a build short in five parts

meaning.en: A short, stocky build with short limbs and torso.
meaning.zh: 四肢和躯干都短小，指个子矮小而粗壮。

examples.zh: 那个五短身材的汉子力气极大。
examples.en: That short, stocky fellow was extremely strong.

examples.zh: 他五短身材，却是篮球场上的灵活后卫。
examples.en: Though short and stocky, he's a nimble guard on the court.

usage.en: Descriptive; may be mildly teasing. The 'five' = limbs and torso/head; not a literal number.
usage.zh: 描写体形，可略带调侃；“五”指四肢和躯干，不是实数。

meaning.en: Heavy snow falling in big flakes like goose feathers.
meaning.zh: 雪花大如鹅毛的大雪。

examples.zh: 窗外下起了鹅毛大雪。
examples.en: Big flakes of snow began falling outside the window.

examples.zh: 鹅毛大雪下了一夜，整个村子都白了。
examples.en: The snow came down all night and the whole village turned white.

usage.en: Descriptive; often in narrative or weather reports. Used of snow only.
usage.zh: 用于描写，多用于叙述和天气；只用于雪。

natural: make up for a fault with merit

meaning.en: To make up for a mistake by doing something worthwhile.
meaning.zh: 用立功来弥补过失。

examples.zh: 他失误丢球后，下半场将功补过，连进两球。
examples.en: After his blunder he made amends in the second half with two goals.

examples.zh: 你要将功补过，把损失追回来。
examples.en: You'd better make amends and recover the loss.

usage.en: Predicate. Compare 将功赎罪, which is for a crime; this one is for an error. Not a variant, though close.
usage.zh: 作谓语。与“将功赎罪”相近，但后者指罪行，前者指过错。

meaning.en: A talented person from one place is employed by a rival; one's own talent being used by others.
meaning.zh: 楚国的人才被晋国任用，比喻本国人才为他国所用。

equivalents: a brain drain to a rival

examples.zh: 这几年的人才外流，成了楚材晋用。
examples.en: This talent exodus has become a case of our talent working for others.

examples.zh: 不重视人才，只会楚材晋用。
examples.en: If you neglect talent, it will only end up serving a rival.

story.en: 'Though Chu has talent, it is Jin that really uses it' (虽楚有材，晋实用之).
story.zh: 《左传·襄公二十六年》：“虽楚有材，晋实用之。”

usage.en: Used when talented people leave for another country or company; usually with regret.
usage.zh: 多含惋惜，用于人才外流。

meaning.en: Missing someone so much that a day feels like three years.
meaning.zh: 一天不见，好像过了三年，形容思念极深。

equivalents: a day apart feels like an age

examples.zh: 他出差的这些天，我真是一日三秋。
examples.en: While he was away on business, every day felt like years.

examples.zh: 异地恋的人最懂什么叫一日三秋。
examples.en: People in long-distance relationships know what 'a day feels like three autumns' means.

story.en: The poem 'Gathering Kudzu': 'One day without seeing you is like three autumns' (一日不见，如三秋兮).
story.zh: 《诗经·王风·采葛》：“一日不见，如三秋兮。”

date.zh: 西周初至春秋中叶 · 前11—前6世纪
date.en: early Western Zhou to mid Spring and Autumn, 11th–6th c. BC

usage.en: A romantic phrase; 秋 means 'year' here. Mostly for lovers or close friends.
usage.zh: 多用于情人或挚友；“秋”指年。

meaning.en: Shamelessly persistent; pestering without regard for dignity.
meaning.zh: 形容厚着脸皮纠缠，不顾羞耻。

examples.zh: 他死皮赖脸地缠着老板要加薪。
examples.en: He pestered the boss shamelessly for a raise.

examples.zh: 别死皮赖脸地跟着我！
examples.en: Stop tagging along like a leech!

usage.en: Casual and negative; used in scolding, sometimes jokingly among friends.
usage.zh: 口语，贬义，用于责备，朋友间也可开玩笑。

meaning.en: A grown woman should marry; usually paired with 男大当婚.
meaning.zh: 女子长大了就应当出嫁；常与“男大当婚”连用。

equivalents: time for a grown daughter to marry

examples.zh: 女大当嫁，家里人开始张罗她的婚事。
examples.en: Her family began arranging her marriage, as a grown daughter should be wed.

examples.zh: 男大当婚，女大当嫁，是父母常挂在嘴边的话。
examples.en: 'A grown man should marry and a grown woman should wed' is what parents often say.

usage.en: Traditional; now often heard as parental pressure. Often 女大不中留 is the cheeky follow-up.
usage.zh: 带传统色彩，现常指父母催婚。

meaning.en: To hold one's feelings in and not show them or act on them.
meaning.zh: 把情绪、不满压在心里，不表现出来。

equivalents: hold one's tongue and bide one's time

examples.zh: 他对不公待遇隐忍不发，等待时机。
examples.en: He held his tongue about the unfair treatment and waited his moment.

examples.zh: 她隐忍不发，实在忍不住才哭了。
examples.en: She bottled it all up and wept only when she couldn't take any more.

usage.en: Can be admirable (self-restraint) or ominous (building up to a blow-up).
usage.zh: 可褒可贬：既指克制，也暗示积压后爆发。

meaning.en: Fabled Daoist paradises on earth; a beautiful, secluded place.
meaning.zh: 道教所说神仙居住的名山胜地，泛指风景优美的地方。

examples.zh: 这座道观坐落在洞天福地之中。
examples.en: The Daoist temple stands in a fabled paradise.

examples.zh: 这片山水，真是人间的洞天福地。
examples.en: These hills and waters are a paradise on earth.

usage.en: Literary and complimentary; used to describe scenic retreats or sacred mountains.
usage.zh: 书面赞语，用于风景优美的隐居之地或名山。

meaning.en: A stranger in a place, knowing neither the people nor the terrain.
meaning.zh: 对当地的人和环境都不熟悉。

equivalents: a stranger in a strange land

examples.zh: 刚到异乡，人地生疏，多亏邻居照顾。
examples.en: Newly arrived and a stranger to the place, I was grateful for my neighbours' help.

examples.zh: 他在这座城市人地生疏，找不到路。
examples.en: He doesn't know anyone or anything in this city and couldn't find his way.

usage.en: Common in everyday speech and writing.
usage.zh: 口语书面皆常见。

natural: cover a thousand li a day

meaning.en: To travel very fast; also to progress rapidly.
meaning.zh: 一天能走一千里，形容速度极快，进步神速。

equivalents: cover enormous distances in a day

examples.zh: 千里马日行千里，普通马追不上。
examples.en: A thoroughbred covers a thousand li a day, which ordinary horses can't match.

examples.zh: 现代高铁几乎能日行千里。
examples.en: Today's high-speed trains can easily cover a thousand li in a day.

usage.en: Literally about a steed or vehicle; figuratively about fast progress, for which 一日千里 is the more usual phrase.
usage.zh: 本义指马、车快；也比喻进步神速，后者常说“一日千里”。

meaning.en: To act at one's own discretion as the situation demands, without waiting for instructions.
meaning.zh: 根据实际情况，自行决定怎么办，不必请示。

examples.zh: 上级授权他便宜行事。
examples.en: His superiors authorised him to act at his discretion.

examples.zh: 事情紧急，你可以便宜行事。
examples.en: It's urgent; you may use your own judgment.

usage.en: 宜 is yí; 便 is biàn ('convenient') not pián. 便宜 pián yi means cheap. Formal authority term.
usage.zh: 此处“便”读biàn，“宜”读yí；与“便宜(pián yi)”（价廉）不同。

natural: the great mansion is about to topple

meaning.en: A great enterprise or regime is about to collapse; a hopeless decline.
meaning.zh: 高楼大厦即将倒塌，比喻局势、事业已到崩溃边缘。

equivalents: the whole edifice about to fall

examples.zh: 王朝末年，大厦将倾，难以挽救。
examples.en: In the dynasty's last years, the edifice was about to fall and could not be saved.

examples.zh: 这家老企业大厦将倾，员工人心惶惶。
examples.en: The old firm is on the verge of collapse and the staff are in a panic.

usage.en: Often continues 一木难支 ('one beam cannot hold it up'): 大厦将倾，一木难支. 厦 is shà here.
usage.zh: 常与“一木难支”并用，如“大厦将倾，一木难支”；“厦”读shà。

meaning.en: To show mercy, often used when pleading for kindness.
meaning.zh: 发出大慈大悲之心，多用于请求对方开恩。

equivalents: be so kind as to help

examples.zh: 求您大发慈悲，放我们一马吧。
examples.en: Please have mercy and let us off.

examples.zh: 他难得大发慈悲，免了我的债务。
examples.en: He rarely does anything so kind; he cancelled my debt.

usage.en: Used sincerely in begging, or jokingly (大发慈悲吧！'be kind, please!'). Buddhist flavour (慈悲).
usage.zh: 可用于真心求情，也可开玩笑；带佛教色彩。
